training_source: SER training on CREMA-D, ESD, MELD, M3ED and Singaporean speech; retained Whisper-medium pretraining sources are incompletely disclosed; upstream seed/base teacher use is counted as seen

columns.audio_path: audio file, relative to the emotion_recognition/ folder
columns.acted_emotion: ground truth: the emotion each speaker was asked to portray, from the first letter of the file name (`A`ngry, `C`alm, `H`appy, `S`ad)
columns.prediction: model prediction: the most probable of the 4 emotions evaluated (angry, happy, neutral, sad)
columns.prediction_all_classes: model prediction: the most probable of all 7 model classes
columns.p_*: model probability of each of its 7 classes (they add up to 1)
